title: Honest Graphs — Data Visualisation for Therapists

hook.en: A graph can tell the truth or tell a lie with exactly the same numbers. A bar chart with a cut-off axis makes a tiny change look huge; a bar of averages hides a whole crowd of patients. Learn to draw graphs that show what really happened, and to spot those that do not.
hook.ur: Graph wohi numbers ke saath sach ya jhoot bol sakta hai. Kata hua axis wala bar chart chhoti tabdeeli ko bara dikhata hai; averages ka bar mareezon ki poori bheed chhupa deta hai. Aise graphs banana seekhein jo dikhayein asal mein kya hua, aur woh pehchanein jo nahi dikhate.

goal.en: By the end, you'll choose a suitable chart for a given question, avoid misleading axes, show individual data instead of just averages, and spot the common tricks used to make results look bigger.
goal.ur: End tak aap diye gaye sawal ke liye munasib chart chunenge, gumrah karne wale axes se bachenge, sirf averages ke bajaye infiradi data dikhayenge, aur nateeje bara dikhane ki aam chaalein pehchanenge.

text.en: A good graph shows **the data honestly, clearly and in context**. For a change over time, use a **line chart**; for comparing groups, show **individual points** with a mean or median and its interval (dot plot, box plot, violin or "raincloud"); for proportions, use a **bar chart that starts at zero**. Always label axes and units, show the **sample size**, and show **uncertainty** (confidence intervals), not just a mean. A bar chart of means with error bars hides the shape of the data.
text.ur: Achha graph **data ko imaandari, saaf aur context mein** dikhata hai. Waqt ke saath tabdeeli ke liye **line chart**; groups ke muqabale ke liye **infiradi points** ke saath mean ya median aur uska interval (dot plot, box plot, violin ya "raincloud"); proportions ke liye **bar chart jo zero se shuru ho**. Hamesha axes aur units par label lagayein, **sample size** dikhayein, aur sirf mean nahi balke **be-yaqeeni** (confidence intervals) bhi dikhayein. Means ke bar chart error bars ke saath data ki shakal chhupa deta hai.

text.en: Think of **a photograph and a postcard**. A postcard picks the nicest view and crops out the rest. A photograph taken honestly shows the whole scene, including the rubbish bins. A misleading graph is a postcard; an honest graph is a photograph.
text.ur: **Tasveer aur postcard** sochein. Postcard sab se khoobsurat manzar chunta hai aur baqi kaat deta hai. Imaandari se kheenchi gayi tasveer poora manzar dikhati hai, kachray ke dibbe bhi. Gumrah karne wala graph postcard hai; imaandar graph tasveer hai.

title.en: Common graph tricks and honest fixes
title.ur: Graph ki aam chaalein aur imaandar hal

rows.en: Starts a bar chart at 80 instead of 0, so a 2-point difference looks huge
rows.ur: Bar chart 0 ke bajaye 80 se shuru karta hai, jis se 2 point ka farq bara lagta hai

rows.en: Start bars at zero, or use dots with a labelled axis and say so
rows.ur: Bars zero se shuru karein, ya label shuda axis ke saath dots istemal karein aur batayein

rows.en: Hides whether the data are spread, skewed or have outliers
rows.ur: Chhupata hai ke data phaila hua, ek taraf jhuka hua ya outliers wala hai

rows.en: Show every patient as a dot, plus the median and interval
rows.ur: Har mareez ko dot ki tarah dikhayein, saath median aur interval

rows.en: Lets two unrelated lines seem to move together
rows.ur: Do ghair mutaliq lakeeron ko saath hilta dikhata hai

rows.en: Use two separate panels with clear scales
rows.ur: Do alag panels saaf scales ke saath istemal karein

rows.en: A big-looking result from 6 patients looks the same as from 600
rows.ur: 6 mareezon ka bara lagta nateeja 600 jaisa dikhta hai

rows.en: Write n on every group and panel
rows.ur: Har group aur panel par n likhein

rows.en: Shows only the weeks that look good
rows.ur: Sirf woh haftay dikhata hai jo achhe lagte hain

rows.en: Show the whole follow-up, including the start

question.en: A bar chart compares two groups' average pain (70 and 72 out of 100) with the y-axis starting at 68. What is wrong?
question.ur: Bar chart do groups ka average dard (100 mein 70 aur 72) dikhata hai aur y-axis 68 se shuru hota hai. Is mein kya ghalat hai?

text.en: The truncated axis makes a 2-point difference look enormous; bars should start at zero, or the difference should be shown honestly with its interval
text.ur: Kata hua axis 2 point ke farq ko bohat bara dikhata hai; bars zero se shuru hone chahiyen, ya farq imaandari se interval ke saath dikhana chahiye

feedback.en: Yes — bar length should represent the value from zero.
feedback.ur: Haan — bar ki lambai zero se value ko dikhani chahiye.

text.en: The bars should be in colour
Nothing, because the axis is labelled
text.ur: Kuch nahi, kyunke axis label shuda hai

feedback.en: A label does not undo the visual exaggeration.
feedback.ur: Label nazar ke mubalghe ko khatam nahi karta.

question.en: Why is a bar chart of group means often not the best way to show small trial data?
question.ur: Chhote trial data dikhane ke liye group means ka bar chart aksar behtareen tareeqa kyun nahi?

text.en: It hides the individual values, the spread and any outliers; dots with a median or mean are more transparent
text.ur: Yeh infiradi values, phailao aur outliers chhupata hai; median ya mean ke saath dots zyada shaffaf hain

feedback.en: Yes — showing the data respects the reader.
feedback.ur: Haan — data dikhana parhne wale ki izzat hai.

feedback.en: They are useful when shown with the data.
feedback.ur: Data ke saath dikhaye jayen to mufeed hain.

question.en: Which chart is best for showing how one patient's pain changed week by week for eight weeks?
question.ur: Ek mareez ka dard aath haftay mein haftay ba haftay kaise badla yeh dikhane ke liye kaun sa chart behtareen hai?

feedback.en: Pie charts show parts of a whole, not change over time.
feedback.ur: Pie charts kul ke hissay dikhate hain, waqt ke saath tabdeeli nahi.

text.en: A line chart with time on the horizontal axis and the pain score on the vertical axis
text.ur: Line chart jis mein ufuqi axis par waqt aur amoodi axis par dard ka score ho

feedback.en: Yes — lines show change over time.
feedback.ur: Haan — lakeerein waqt ke saath tabdeeli dikhati hain.

feedback.en: It does not show the trajectory.

text.en: **Making the graph look impressive instead of true.** 3D effects, shadows, too many colours and decorative icons add noise and can mislead. Keep the design plain, label directly, use colour sparingly and check that it is readable for people with colour-vision deficiency. Another trap is hiding bad news: report outcomes that did not improve, not only the ones that did.
text.ur: **Graph ko sachchai ke bajaye mutasir-kun banana.** 3D asraat, saaye, bohat se rang aur sajawati icons shor barhate hain aur gumrah kar sakte hain. Design saada rakhein, seedha label lagayein, rang kam istemal karein aur dekhein ke rang-andhay logon ke liye parhne ke qabil hai. Ek aur jaal buri khabar chhupana hai: jo nateeje behtar nahi hue woh bhi report karein, sirf jo hue woh nahi.

text.en: **Show patients their own graph.** A simple line chart of their pain or walking distance across visits is more motivating than any explanation. Draw it by hand if needed. Add a dotted line for their goal. Patients who see their progress, even a slow one, stay engaged, and patients who see a plateau can talk about it early.
text.ur: **Mareezon ko unka apna graph dikhayein.** Visits ke dauran dard ya chalne ke fasle ka saada line chart kisi bhi wazahat se zyada hausla deta hai. Zaroorat ho to haath se banayein. Unke maqsad ke liye dotted line jorein. Jo mareez apni pesh-raft dekhte hain, chahe dheeri ho, juday rehte hain, aur jo thehraav dekhte hain woh jaldi us par baat kar sakte hain.

question.en: Why do researchers now recommend showing raw data points?
question.ur: Muhaqqiq ab raw data points dikhane ki sifarish kyun karte hain?

answer.en: Very different data sets can give the same mean and error bar. A bar chart cannot tell whether the average comes from consistent responses or from a few big responders and many non-responders. Showing the dots reveals the pattern, outliers and sample size at a glance, and it makes it harder to mislead, intentionally or not.
answer.ur: Bohat mukhtalif data sets ek hi mean aur error bar de sakte hain. Bar chart nahi bata sakta ke average mustaqil jawabon se aaya hai ya chand bade responders aur bohat se non-responders se. Dots dikhana ek nazar mein pattern, outliers aur sample size zahir karta hai, aur gumrah karna, jaan boojh kar ya nahi, mushkil kar deta hai.

beats.patient: A clinic report shows a bar chart: "Average pain fell from 6.8 to 3.1 after our programme". It has no sample size and no spread. A colleague asks for the data. There were 14 patients; 10 improved a lot, 2 barely changed, and 2 got worse.
beats.assessment: The average is true, but the chart hides the two who did not improve and the small sample.
beats.treatment: They redraw it as a paired dot plot with lines for each patient, add n = 14 and note the two who worsened and what was done for them.
beats.reassess: The report becomes honest and more useful: the team investigates why two patients did not improve, and improves the programme.

text.en: **Never hide harm in a chart.** If some patients got worse, show them. Aggregated averages that bury adverse events are a safety problem. Report the numbers who had adverse events, in plain language and in the same prominence as the benefits.
text.ur: **Nuqsan graph mein kabhi na chhupayein.** Agar kuch mareez bigre to unhein dikhayein. Jama shuda averages jo adverse events dabate hain safety ka masla hain. Adverse events wale mareezon ki ginti saade alfaaz mein aur faide jitni numayaan tareeqe se report karein.

text.en: Weissgerber and colleagues reviewed physiology papers and found that most used bar and line graphs for continuous data in small samples, which can hide the distribution, and they recommended showing individual data points, using dot plots, box plots or violin plots, and providing tools to make this easier. Tufte's principles of graphical integrity, such as that the representation of numbers should be directly proportional to the quantities represented and should avoid distortion, remain widely used guidance for honest graphs.
text.ur: Weissgerber aur saathiyon ne physiology ke papers ka jaiza liya aur paya ke zyada tar ne chhote samples mein continuous data ke liye bar aur line graphs istemal kiye, jo taqseem chhupa sakte hain, aur unhon ne infiradi data points dikhane, dot plots, box plots ya violin plots istemal karne ki sifarish ki. Tufte ke graphical integrity ke usool, jaise ke numbers ki numaindagi dikhaye gaye miqdaron ke seedhe mutanasib ho aur bigaad se bache, imaandar graphs ke liye wasi taur par istemal hone wali rehnumai hain.

text.en: **Zero, Dots, n, Uncertainty.** Start bars at zero, show the dots, state n, and show uncertainty.
text.ur: **Zero, Dots, n, Be-yaqeeni.** Bars zero se shuru karein, dots dikhayein, n likhein, aur be-yaqeeni dikhayein.

summary.en: Show data honestly: bars start at zero, individual points are visible, n is stated and uncertainty is shown.
summary.ur: Data imaandari se dikhayein: bars zero se shuru, infiradi points nazar aayen, n likha ho aur be-yaqeeni dikhayi jaye.

summary.en: Match the chart to the question: line charts for change over time, dot or box plots for group comparisons.
summary.ur: Chart ko sawal se milayein: waqt ke saath tabdeeli ke liye line charts, groups ke muqabale ke liye dot ya box plots.

summary.en: Do not hide non-responders or harm, and keep the design plain and readable.
summary.ur: Non-responders ya nuqsan na chhupayein, aur design saada aur parhne ke qabil rakhein.

front.en: Where should a bar chart start?
front.ur: Bar chart kahan se shuru hona chahiye?

front.en: What chart suits change over time?
front.ur: Waqt ke saath tabdeeli ke liye kaun sa chart?

back.en: They reveal spread, outliers and sample size that bars of means hide.
back.ur: Yeh phailao, outliers aur sample size dikhate hain jo means ke bars chhupate hain.

front.en: Name a sign of a misleading graph.
front.ur: Gumrah karne wale graph ki ek nishani batayein.

back.en: A cut-off axis, hidden sample size or dual axes.
back.ur: Kata hua axis, chhupa sample size ya do axes.
